engineering_question: Can any registered rigid-kernel projection certify a bolt067 exceedance using the same continuous-model candidate1, correction box, full gap, necessary functional and support, or must the next proof change one of those certificates?
limits: Reuse two frozen auxiliary candidates from the original-load and refined-mixed records. Independently certify both with the same complete continuous rigid matrix, original load, selected minor and existing rank bound. No LP, inverse, factorization or response is computed.

The exact null vector is the difference of two corrected balanced duals; the explicit raw candidate difference generally is not null. Bound its action from below and dual density norm from above using the sum of both certified correction radii.

Embed each normal weight as uniform pressure on its own existing certified disjoint material support. Its exact dual norm uses kappa*area. Continuous virtual actions retain their complete whole-patch metric, including material outside those supports; the finite average-row metric is not substituted for it.

The second candidate is only an annihilator proof witness. Preserve the first candidate, its correction box and full upper gap certificate, the frozen functional and fixed-point work, support and working divisor 5.

For all 800 registered rigid-kernel directions the corrected dual difference annihilates the original load map. Weighted Cauchy bounds the full projection metric from below; the first corrected dual anchors every shifted center and offset. No projection or optimum is selected.

The resulting ceiling limits necessary lower endpoints from this same fixed generic gap/Cauchy certificate family. It is not an upper resistance index, actual pass/failure or complete joint/member qualification. New gaps, candidates/boxes, functionals/supports or sharper theorems remain outside the conclusion.

The fixed model and unmeasured constitutive hypotheses are unchanged. Physical stiffness/contact/restraint applicability, finite geometry and complete resistance remain open. Keep current 100 bolts and 66 Hillman axes, rejected proposal history, deferred panel/screw exceedances, excluded actual fit and blank observations.

primary_methods.extension: The all-owner null-witness and pressure-embedding Cauchy argument is derived explicitly here; the generic published duality method does not itself qualify the physical joint.
